conceptProposals.label: Drink
conceptProposals.definition: Consume a liquid; alcohol, container and manner variants require separate review.

conceptProposals.label: Want
conceptProposals.definition: Desire something; not lack, need, or a negated desire.

conceptProposals.label: Need
conceptProposals.definition: Require something; intensity and modality are not inferred from an isolated clip.

conceptProposals.label: Where
conceptProposals.definition: Ask about a location; question nonmanuals are required.

conceptProposals.label: Who
conceptProposals.definition: Ask about a person; not a relative-clause mapping.

conceptProposals.label: When
conceptProposals.definition: Ask about time; not a conditional or relative clause.

conceptProposals.label: Why
conceptProposals.definition: Ask about a reason; not a complete sentence template.

conceptProposals.label: How
conceptProposals.definition: Ask about manner; not quantity, age, or a complete greeting.

conceptProposals.label: Good
conceptProposals.definition: Positive quality; not GOOD-NIGHT, THANK-YOU or a complete evaluation.

conceptProposals.label: Bad
conceptProposals.definition: Negative quality; not a sentence-level negation substitute.

conceptProposals.label: Happy
conceptProposals.definition: A feeling of happiness; facial expression requires review.

conceptProposals.label: Sad
conceptProposals.definition: A feeling of sadness; facial expression requires review.

conceptProposals.label: Work
conceptProposals.definition: Labor or employment; not function correctly, operate, or an artwork.

conceptProposals.label: School
conceptProposals.definition: A place or institution for education; not a group of fish.

conceptProposals.label: Home
conceptProposals.definition: A residence or home; not a sports home team.

conceptProposals.label: Mother
conceptProposals.definition: A mother or female parent; compound family terms require separate mappings.

conceptProposals.label: Sister
conceptProposals.definition: A female sibling; not a religious title or metaphorical relation.

conceptProposals.label: Name
conceptProposals.definition: A name identifying a person; not the verb appoint, and not a name sign for a person.

conceptProposals.label: Know
conceptProposals.definition: Have knowledge; not know-how or sentence-level negation.

conceptProposals.label: Understand
conceptProposals.definition: Comprehend information; not a complete question or a negative statement.

conceptProposals.label: Learn
conceptProposals.definition: Acquire knowledge; not teach or a reviewed inflected sentence.

conceptProposals.label: Go
conceptProposals.definition: Move away or toward a destination; direction and referents require review.

conceptProposals.label: Come
conceptProposals.definition: Move toward a referent; not an invitation sentence template.

conceptProposals.label: Stop
conceptProposals.definition: Cease an action; not a bus stop or a full imperative sentence.

conceptProposals.label: Sorry
conceptProposals.definition: An expression of apology; not sorrow or a complete polite sentence.
